pergunta: What is essential to keep the dogs looking good according to Audrey?
ouro: Daily brushing, regular baths, nail trims, and lots of love

Session date: 3:52 pm on 27 July, 2023
[D13:1] Andrew: Hey Audrey! How are you? My GF and I just had a great experience volunteering at a pet shelter on Monday - it was so rewarding! We loved spending time with those cute animals and it gave us so much joy. It was so rewarding, it reminded me just how much I love them!
[D13:2] Audrey: Hi Andrew! I'm good, thanks. That's awesome about the pet shelter volunteering. Helping animals really is great and you can tell when they're happy! So happy for you getting to experience that! I should do that someday too!
[D13:3] Andrew: Thanks! Seeing them so content makes me happy, it really makes me realize how special and full of love they are! Have you ever volunteered at an animal shelter? It can be so rewarding. 
[...]
[D13:5] Andrew: Aww that's a cute photo! How are their personalities? Tell me more!
[D13:6] Audrey: Well the oldest one is the most relaxed, like a wise old sage. The second one is always ready for a game. The third one can be naughty but loves a good cuddle. And the youngest one is full of life and always up for an adventure. They all have their own individual personalities and I adore them.
[D13:7] Andrew: Wow, they sound amazing! They must remind you of your childhood pup. That photo of you with your dog is so cute, he looks like the most playful one ever! Pets really do bring so much joy in your life!
[...]
Session date: 11:05 am on 4 August, 2023
[D14:1] Andrew: Hey, Audrey! I can't wait for the weekend. My girlfriend, Toby and I are going camping. It's been forever since I've been in nature.
[D14:2] Audrey: That's awesome! That must be fun! I just started agility classes with my pups at a dog park. It's awesome to watch them learn and build relationships with other dogs. Seeing them face and conquer challenges really warms my heart.
[D14:3] Andrew: Wow it's amazing to watch them grow together. They look so cool overcoming obstacles like that. Impressive stuff!
[...]
[D14:13] Andrew: Yeah, nature really calms me down and relaxes my mind. It's like a break from the craziness of city living.
[D14:14] Audrey: Yeah! It's a refuge from the busy city life and it's even better when you can share it with someone special. My pets have been my good ol' buddies during all the tough times! They make me so happy and I love them so much.
[D14:15] Andrew: Agreed! Sharing something you enjoy with someone is great. Plus, those types of bonds bring loads of joy and love.

Session date: 7:59 pm on 4 November, 2023
[D27:5] Andrew: That looks fun! Seeing those adorable pups made me think about getting another dog, but I'm still not sure. Having two dogs is already a lot to take care of. Do you have any tips on being a multi-dog pet owner?
[D27:6] Audrey: Maybe you want to take care of Toby and Buddy first. Having them happy and healthy would be a good first step before going all in for more dogs.
[D27:7] Andrew: Thanks, I think that's what I need to hear. I'll take good care of my dogs first.
[D27:8] Audrey: That's great! Let me know if you need any help, I'm here for you! See how happy they are? You don't need more dogs to make them happy! :)
[...]
[D27:11] Andrew: Wow, it's great to know there are ways to keep them active in the city. I'll keep that in mind. Thank you so much!
[D27:12] Audrey: You got it! There are lots of ways to keep them happy in the city. Make sure to socialize and exercise them daily. Get creative and add some mental stimulation too. Here's a pic of them playing fetch in the park - they love it!
[D27:13] Andrew: That's so cute! What sort of activities do you do to stay mentally stimulated?
[D27:14] Audrey: We give them lots of activities to keep them busy - puzzles, training, hide-and-seek - they love it all!
[D27:15] Andrew: Cool ideas! I think I'll give those activities a try with my pups. Thanks!

Session date: 9:02 am on 22 November, 2023
[D28:2] Andrew: Hey Audrey! Nice to hear from you. Sounds adorable! Do you have any pictures of them all groomed up?
[D28:3] Audrey: Here's a pic of them, looking all groomed. Look at those shiny coats! To top it off, they were really good at the salon - I always worry about them in new places.
[D28:4] Andrew: Wow, they look great! Love seeing them happy and calm in new places.
[D28:5] Audrey: Thanks! It means a lot to see them happy and settled in new places. I guess I'm doing a good job as a doggy mom then, haha! Have you taken your furry friends to the groomers yet?
[D28:6] Andrew: No, we haven't got the chance to take them to the groomer yet. But will do that soon! So guess what, I can't help myself but to adpot another dog the other day. Here's a photo of the doggo!
[...]
[D28:10] Andrew: Thanks! We're gonna take Scout, Toby, and Buddy to a nearby park. It's not big, but we can all have fun and get some fresh air!
[D28:11] Audrey: Sounds like a great start for Scout! Start small, and gradually give them more exposure. They'll have a great time, just make sure to keep them leashed.
[D28:12] Andrew: Yeah, safety first! For now, we're keeping the new addition on a leash while they get used to being outside. That pic you of your dog at the park is so cute. So we got some essentials for their comfort and entertainment, like a bed, toys, and some puppy pads just in case. It's like their own little safe haven.
[...]
[D28:15] Audrey: They're doing great! Exploring, meeting new people...they feel so loved and safe. I'm really glad they're part of my life!
[D28:16] Andrew: That's great to hear! Dogs truly bring so much joy and friendship. I'm glad they're happy with you.
[D28:17] Audrey: Thanks! They're really awesome and bring so much joy and friendship. I'm so grateful to have them in my life as a part of my family.
[D28:18] Andrew: Yeah, it's great! Dogs are always there for us. We should count ourselves lucky to have such amazing furry friends as family member.
